candidates.change_summary: Remove the access-control check so anyone can call withdrawAll.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may call withdrawAll.
Remove the internal withdraw call so withdrawAll no longer transfers the contract balance.
Withdraw depositsCount wei instead of the full contract balance.
Withdraw zero wei instead of the full contract balance, leaving funds in the contract.
Withdraw the entire contract balance instead of the requested _value.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw performs no ether transfer.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may call guarded functions.
Remove the revert on failed external call so sendMoney succeeds even when the sub-call fails.
Invert the failure condition so sendMoney reverts when the sub-call succeeds instead of when it fails.
Drop the onlyOwner modifier so any address may call sendMoney.
Replace the access-check requirement with a vacuous one so sendMoney succeeds for non-owner callers.
Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers the contract balance to the owner.
Drop the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so any caller can drain the contract's balance.
